scope: Documentary eligibility screening of at most three application candidates already in the local archive.
scientific_question: Can the application document a current exposure, a later outcome, an admissible pre-exposure history, and an interpretable comparison between retaining that history and adding a current control on a common sample?
forbidden_selection_information: signs or magnitudes of treatment coefficients
results selected because they favor the proposed method
allowed_sources: local full text of the original study
original replication README, codebook, questionnaire, appendix, and data documentation
original do-files or scripts, read only for variable definitions, timing, sample construction, specification, and clustering
read-only inspection of file names, variable names, labels, storage types, and panel keys without computing shifts, models, or substantive summaries
unit_of_screening: study-design and one substantively named current-control contrast; multiple controls from the same study do not create independent applications

criteria.name: current_intervention_defined
criteria.requirement: The exposure or intervention D is substantively defined, attached to a unit and period, and distinguishable from eligibility, assignment, receipt, intensity, or a proxy. Its current-period meaning is documented by a primary source.
criteria.pass_rule: Primary documentation identifies what changes, for whom, and when.
criteria.fail_rule: Primary documentation demonstrates that D cannot be dated or does not represent an intervention/exposure at the analysis unit.
criteria.missing_rule: D appears in code or data but its timing or substantive meaning is not documented.

criteria.name: exposure_to_outcome_window
criteria.requirement: The outcome Y and its reference interval are documented, and the ordering D -> Y is defensible. Same-period measures require documented within-period ordering; otherwise they remain ambiguous.
criteria.pass_rule: Primary documentation provides dates or intervals sufficient to order exposure and outcome.
criteria.fail_rule: Primary documentation places Y before D or makes the proposed outcome a component of D.
criteria.missing_rule: Labels such as current, annual, or five-year are present without dates or ordering sufficient to establish the window.

criteria.name: pre_exposure_history_available
criteria.requirement: The archive contains or documents pre-exposure measures needed to define a baseline history for Y and the candidate control Z without using post-exposure values as history.
criteria.pass_rule: Variables, time indices, and construction rules identify at least one genuinely pre-exposure Y and Z measure; the exact admissible lag order remains for Gates 2-3.
criteria.fail_rule: Primary documentation demonstrates that all available Y or Z measures occur at or after exposure.
criteria.missing_rule: Earlier measures may exist, but their dates, construction, or alignment with exposure are not documented.

criteria.name: documented_support_and_comparison
criteria.requirement: The design documents repeated exposure variation and a substantively relevant contemporaneous comparison, such as unexposed/lower-exposed units or within-unit changes, without conditioning on future outcomes.
criteria.pass_rule: The paper or replication design states the source of treatment variation and the comparison used.
criteria.fail_rule: The documented sample has no exposure contrast at the relevant time or defines comparison groups using future outcomes.
criteria.missing_rule: A model is listed, but the source and timing of identifying variation are not documented.

criteria.name: panel_cluster_structure
criteria.requirement: Repeated unit and time identifiers are available, and the primary analysis documents a cluster or dependence level that can be reconstructed. Suitability of the eventual inference method is provisional until Gate 3.
criteria.pass_rule: The archive identifies unit, time, and the primary clustering/dependence structure.
criteria.fail_rule: The application is cross-sectional or lacks any repeated unit/time structure needed for the proposed history comparison.
criteria.missing_rule: Panel identifiers exist but clustering, dependence, or effective cluster count is undocumented.

criteria.name: data_and_documentation_accessible
criteria.requirement: Data required for the intended comparison are locally accessible or publicly recoverable from a primary repository, and variables can be mapped from documentation to files without reconstructing protected or unavailable inputs.
criteria.pass_rule: Local data plus primary documentation and specification code identify D, Y, Z, unit, time, sample restrictions, and clustering variables.
criteria.fail_rule: Required variables or records are documented as unavailable, restricted without access, or absent from the archived data.
criteria.missing_rule: Files exist but essential variables cannot yet be mapped or provenance is incomplete.

criteria.name: substantively_relevant_control_contrast
criteria.requirement: A named Z has both a pre-exposure historical role and a current value whose causal role could differ after D. Adding current Z while retaining documented history answers a real specification decision in the study; it is not created by merely relabeling a subscript.
criteria.pass_rule: Primary substantive reasoning and timing make both historical adjustment and current-control interpretation relevant.
criteria.fail_rule: The archived design documents Z only as time-invariant, only post-outcome, or unrelated to the exposure-outcome process.
criteria.missing_rule: Current and lagged Z can be constructed, but no primary source documents why the contrast matters or when Z is measured.

classification_rule.ELIGIBLE_DOCUMENTARY: All E1-E7 pass. Only this status permits provisional principal or reserve selection.
classification_rule.HOLD_DOCUMENTATION: No criterion is demonstrably failed, but one or more criteria have missing documentation. This is not evidence of substantive ineligibility.
classification_rule.INELIGIBLE_DEMONSTRATED: At least one criterion fails on affirmative primary-source evidence.
classification_rule.NOT_SCREENED: Not among the at-most-three candidates selected for full documentary screening.

candidate_selection_rule.stage_1: Start from the Gate 0 archive and rank study-designs without consulting forbidden selection information.
candidate_selection_rule.stage_2: Prioritize a clearly dated exposure-outcome clock, reconstructible pre-history, local data and code, documented panel/clustering, and a control with a credible changing temporal role.
candidate_selection_rule.stage_3: Screen at most three study-designs in that order and record why other archive groups were not selected for full screening.
candidate_selection_rule.principal_reserve: Choose principal and reserve only among ELIGIBLE_DOCUMENTARY candidates. Selection is provisional until the joint Gate 3 compatibility check and cannot be changed because a later estimate is small, null, or unfavorable.

stopping_rule: Stop after three full screenings, or earlier if two ELIGIBLE_DOCUMENTARY candidates allow principal and reserve selection. If none passes, specify a bounded additional search or a descriptive route for the author; do not manufacture eligibility by changing notation.
downstream_limits: Gate 1 documentary eligibility does not establish causal identification, estimator compatibility, sufficient pre-periods, adequate effective clusters, statistical support, or novelty. Those require Gates 2-5.
